name: Freinsheim (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the city arms of Freinsheim (a yellow lion on blue above grapes and a red letter F on white).
history: Municipal flag of Freinsheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Freinsheim arms — lion, grapes and letter F
